title: Salman Khan Returns for Bigg Boss 20 as JioStar Launches Six Simultaneous Language Editions
excerpt: The franchise's biggest season yet will span Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, and Bangla, with cricket legend Sourav Ganguly joining the host lineup.
body:
• JioStar will launch six editions of Bigg Boss simultaneously starting September 2026 across Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, and Bangla — the first time all editions air together.
  • Salman Khan returns to host the Hindi edition, with Vijay Sethupathi, Nagarjuna, Kichcha Sudeepa, Mohanlal, and newcomer Sourav Ganguly hosting regional editions.
  • In 2025, the franchise recorded 500 million reach, 438 billion viewing minutes with 47% year-on-year growth in engagement, and attracted over 625 advertisers.
  • The Hindi edition is set to premiere on September 21, with casting already underway for the milestone 20th season.

India's Biggest Reality Show Goes Pan-India

JioStar has announced its most ambitious Bigg Boss season yet: six language editions launching simultaneously starting September 2026. The editions will span Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, and Bangla, airing on the JioStar television network and streaming on JioHotstar. It marks the first time all editions have been released together, turning the franchise's festive-season run into a pan-India event.

Salman Khan, who has become inseparable from the franchise's identity, is confirmed to return as host of the Hindi edition. The 20th season — a milestone for Indian television — is scheduled to premiere on September 21, according to industry reports. Khan is currently balancing hosting duties with filming an untitled action thriller directed by Vamsi Paidipally, co-starring Nayanthara.

A Star-Studded Host Lineup

The regional editions bring together some of Indian cinema's biggest names. Vijay Sethupathi will host the Tamil edition, Nagarjuna takes Telugu, Kichcha Sudeepa returns for Kannada, and Mohanlal anchors Malayalam. The headline addition is cricket legend Sourav Ganguly, who joins the franchise for the first time as host of the Bangla edition — a move that signals JioStar's ambition to deepen the show's reach in eastern India.

To mark the occasion, JioStar has unveiled India's Bigg Reality, a coffee table book chronicling the franchise's two-decade journey, its cultural influence, and its commercial impact on Indian entertainment.

"Over the last two decades, Bigg Boss has consistently reinvented itself, growing in scale, engagement and cultural relevance with every season. This festive season marks our biggest milestone yet."

— Mahesh Shetty, Head, Entertainment Sales, TV, JioStar

The Numbers Behind the Franchise

Bigg Boss's scale is staggering. In 2025, the franchise recorded a reach of over 500 million viewers and generated 438 billion viewing minutes across its six language editions — a 47% year-on-year growth in engagement. On JioHotstar, six in every ten viewers watch the 24/7 live feed, and more than 9.32 billion votes have been cast over the franchise's lifetime.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=K8noeQa4bT4

The commercial engine is equally formidable. More than 625 brands used the platform in 2025 to launch products and build consumer connections, spanning 46 categories including 49 first-time advertisers. Brand integrations ranged from Mamaearth's specialized tasks to Jar App's user acquisition campaign on Bigg Boss Kannada. Average uplifts of 1.33 times in awareness, 1.26 times in consideration, and 1.25 times in purchase intent make the show one of Indian television's most effective advertising vehicles.

What the Diaspora Can Expect

For NRI audiences, the multi-language format is significant. International viewers in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia will have access to nightly episodes through premium streaming extensions and partnered South Asian satellite feeds. The 24/7 live feed on JioHotstar has already established a global viewing habit, and the simultaneous six-edition launch gives diaspora viewers more reasons to stay connected to the cultural moment back home.

Casting for the Hindi edition is underway, with the production team reaching out to established television names, digital personalities, and reality show veterans. Format details and twists remain under wraps, but the show's producers at Endemol Shine India are reportedly planning an expanded format befitting the 20th-season milestone.
